# OpenFurqan

> A free, modern Quran reader for reading, studying, memorizing, and listening to the Quran online.

Website: https://openfurqan.com

## About

OpenFurqan is a free, open web application for reading and studying the Holy Quran. It provides the full Arabic text of the Quran alongside translations in multiple languages, word-by-word analysis, audio recitation from 16 reciters, Anki-style spaced repetition memorization, Surah/Juz/Page reading views, prayer times, and study tools. No account or payment is required.

## Content

- 114 Surahs (chapters) of the Holy Quran
- 6,236 Ayahs (verses) with full Arabic text
- 20+ translations across 9+ languages
- Word-by-word Arabic analysis with root dictionary

## Translations Available

English: Sahih International, Yusuf Ali, Pickthall, Arberry, Haleem, Muhsin Khan, Taqi Usmani, Ahmed Raza, Maarif-ul-Quran, Transliteration
Bangla: Muhiuddin Khan, Hoque
Urdu: Bayan-ul-Quran, Kanzu al-Iman
German: Bubenheim
Spanish: Cortes
French: Hamidullah
Hindi: Hindi
Turkish: Suleyman Ates
Sinhala: Naseem Ismail

## Audio Reciters

16 reciters available: Mishary Rashid Alafasy, Abdurrahman As-Sudais, Saud Ash-Shuraym, Abu Bakr Ash-Shaatree, Maher Al-Muaiqly, Hani Rifai, Abdul Basit (Murattal), Abdul Basit (Mujawwad), Mahmoud Khalil Al-Husary, Al-Husary (Muallim), Mohamed Siddiq Al-Minshawi, Saad Al-Ghamdi, Ahmed ibn Ali al-Ajmy, Abdullah Ali Jabir, Khalifah Al Tunaiji, Yasser Ad-Dussary. Adjustable playback speed and continuous surah playback.

## Features

- Read the Quran online with clean, distraction-free design
- Three reading views: Surah (chapter), Juz (para, all 30), and Page (all 604 mushaf pages)
- Multiple translations side by side
- Audio recitation from 16 reciters with adjustable speed
- Anki-style spaced repetition memorization (SRS) with flashcards, ratings (Again/Hard/Good/Easy), audio autoplay, session stats, streak tracking, and session sharing
- Hifz memorization mode with repetition loops and ayah range selection
- Word-by-word Arabic meanings, root analysis, and Lane's Lexicon definitions
- 15+ color-coded Tajweed pronunciation rules
- 7+ Tafsir editions (Maarif-ul-Quran, Maududi, Ahsanul Bayaan, Mokhtasar, Al-Jalalayn, Kashf Al-Asrar, Hindi Tafseer)
- Study Mode with bookmarks, personal notes, reading plans, and progress tracking
- Advanced search with key verses, topic exploration, and recent search history
- Reading progress saved per surah, juz, and page
- Reading statistics: daily verses, time spent, streaks, and long-term history
- Prayer times based on user location (31+ countries, 11+ calculation methods)
- 4 visual themes with smooth transitions (Dark, Parchment, Black & White, Dark B&W)
- 4 Arabic fonts (KFGQPC Hafs, Hafs Smart, Scheherazade New, Uthman Naskh)
- Uthmani and Naskh script styles
- Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile with swipe navigation
- Offline support (Progressive Web App)
- No ads, no accounts, completely free

## URL Structure

- Homepage: https://openfurqan.com
- Surah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}
- Ayah page: https://openfurqan.com/surah/{surah-slug}/{ayah-number}
- Memorization: https://openfurqan.com/memorization
